title: VGA picture (640 x 480)
summary: Connect any VGA monitor with 8 resistors: a 320 x 240 picture with 16 colours (out of 64), text, lines, graphs, all drawn from Python.
wiring: VGA pin 1 (red) through 470 ohm and 1 kohm
the two resistors join at the VGA pin: a 2-bit DAC
VGA pin 2 (green) through 470 ohm and 1 kohm
VGA pin 3 (blue) through 470 ohm and 1 kohm
parts: VGA connector (DB15 female) or a cut VGA cable
3 x 470 ohm, 3 x 1 kohm, 2 x 100 ohm resistors
a VGA monitor (or an HDMI monitor with a VGA adapter)
tested: the self-test passed 7 of 7 checks on the real board (October 2026), with nothing connected.
